purpose: Define a stable supplied-option decision interface and per-task evidence gates without claiming product quality or inventing an end-user task battery.

request_contract.criterion: explicit question, instruction, or task criterion; may be empty only for a frozen task contract that defines the criterion out of band

options.order_requirement: preserve caller-supplied option order end to end

ordinal_score.field: strictly increasing finite numeric value per supplied option

text.guard: Do not encode the target label or correct option in the state or criterion.

image.asset_integrity: Pin source identity and content hash; state crop/resize/preprocessing in the task protocol.

audio.temporal_metadata: When the task uses a segment, record start/end times and the clock reference.

video.temporal_metadata: Preserve frame order and record timestamps, sampling policy, and source clock for temporal tasks.

sensor.guard: A sensor route is optional and is not part of the first required modality battery.

joint.guard: Do not claim that multiple inputs are needed until matched unimodal, missing, shuffled, stale/time-offset, and contradiction controls pass on a rights-cleared independent-group task.

response_contract.probability_requirements: finite values in [0,1], same length/order as supplied options, sum to 1 within 1e-5; selected_option_id must have maximum probability
response_contract.confidence_semantics: probability assigned to the selected option; JSON shape validity does not establish calibration

abstention.evaluation: Count abstentions as incorrect for all-query accuracy and report covered-only metrics and coverage separately.

evaluation_policy.baseline_gate: NLL and Brier must improve over both uniform-option and train-only majority-class baselines using paired source-group uncertainty.
evaluation_policy.selection_gate: Any calibration or model selection uses training/calibration groups only; locked evaluation groups are not reused for tuning.
evaluation_policy.joint_input_gate: The fused model must improve both accuracy and NLL over the best unimodal control under paired source-group uncertainty and pass frozen missing/shuffled/stale/time-offset/contradiction controls.
unresolved_release_inputs: fresh locked evaluation cohort per task

known_development_tasks.task: Typed Decisions Synth synthetic option decisions

non_claims: This contract does not select a product task battery or deployment device.
Schema-valid probabilities are not evidence of calibrated probabilities.
Passing one modality-specific benchmark does not qualify another modality or a joint-input task.
The current Path A runtime and its observed development results do not meet the full release gates by virtue of this contract.
